requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder incorrectly overrides the __call__ method, causing RuntimeError: super(): no arguments. This happens because the override doesn't properly invoke the parent constructor with required arguments.
requirement.contract: Remove the problematic __call__ method override from AsyncOptionBuilder. The class should inherit the properly functioning __call__ method from the parent Builder class, which correctly handles synchronous generators.

requirement.description: The base Builder.__call__ method uses unreliable attribute checking to detect async generators, causing incorrect classification of generators and inappropriate TypeError messages.
requirement.contract: Replace the unreliable attribute-based detection in Builder.__call__ with proper isinstance() checking using collections.abc.AsyncGenerator to accurately distinguish between async and sync generators.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method fails when processing list iterators (from Seq.empty()) because it tries to pass them to the parent's __call__ method which expects generators with send() method.
requirement.contract: Fix SeqBuilder.__call__ to properly handle list iterators and other non-generator iterables by converting them to proper generators before processing, or implement direct handling for such cases instead of delegating to parent.
